cases.sentence: Когда приближался иудейский ___ шалашей, братья Иисуса сказали ему
cases.translation: When the Jewish Feast of Booths was approaching, the brothers of Jesus said to him
cases.explain: Праздник is the subject of the verb приближался ('was approaching'), so it stands in the nominative case.
The preposition из ('from') always requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Никодим, один из фарисеев, который как-то раньше приходил к ___, спросил
cases.translation: Nicodemus, one of the Pharisees who had come to Jesus before, asked
cases.explain: The preposition к ('to, toward') governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Первая половина праздника уже прошла, когда Иисус пришел в ___ и стал учить.
cases.translation: The first half of the feast had already passed when Jesus came into the temple and began to teach.
cases.explain: The preposition в ('into') with the verb of motion пришёл requires the accusative case; since храм is an inanimate masculine noun, its accusative form is identical to the nominative.

cases.sentence: Вот же он открыто говорит перед ___, и ему не запрещают.
cases.translation: Look, he is speaking openly before the people, and they say nothing to him.
cases.explain: The preposition перед ('before, in front of') governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Jesus openly preaches in the temple.
cases.explain: The preposition в ('in'), showing location rather than motion, requires the prepositional case.

reading.ru: После этого Иисус ходил по Галилее.
reading.question: Where did Jesus go about after these events?
reading.explain: The text says Jesus walked about in Galilee because the Jews in Judea wanted to kill him.

reading.ru: Даже его братья не верили ему.
reading.question: What does this sentence tell us about Jesus' brothers?
options: They did not believe in him
reading.correct: They did not believe in him
reading.explain: The sentence states plainly that even his brothers did not believe in him.

reading.ru: Но когда его братья пошли на праздник, он тоже пошел, только не открыто, а так, чтобы никто не знал.
reading.question: How did Jesus go up to the feast?
options: Secretly, so that no one would know
He refused to go at all
Riding on a donkey with a crowd
reading.correct: Secretly, so that no one would know
reading.explain: The text says he went not openly but secretly, so no one would know.

reading.ru: Иудеи удивлялись и спрашивали, «Откуда у него такая ученость, ведь он нигде не учился?»
reading.question: What amazed the Jews about Jesus when he taught in the temple?
options: His learning, since he had never studied anywhere
reading.correct: His learning, since he had never studied anywhere
reading.explain: The Jews wondered where his learning came from, since he had never been educated.

reading.ru: Зачем вы хотите убить меня? Да ты не одержим ли? Кто хочет тебя убить?» — отвечал народ.
reading.question: How did the crowd respond when Jesus said people wanted to kill him?
options: They denied it and said he must be demon-possessed
They admitted the plot and apologized
reading.correct: They denied it and said he must be demon-possessed
reading.explain: The crowd answered by accusing Jesus of being possessed and denying anyone wanted to kill him.

reading.ru: Они хотели схватить Иисуса, но никто не поднял на него руки, потому что его время еще не настало.
reading.question: Why did no one seize Jesus even though they wanted to?
options: Because his hour had not yet come
Because he had already left the city
reading.correct: Because his hour had not yet come
reading.explain: The text explains that no one laid a hand on him because his time had not yet come.

reading.ru: Фарисеи услышали, что говорят об Иисусе в толпе, и поэтому первосвященники и фарисеи послали храмовую стражу, чтобы арестовать его.
reading.question: Who did the chief priests and Pharisees send to arrest Jesus?
reading.explain: After hearing the murmuring in the crowd, the chief priests and Pharisees sent the temple guard to arrest him.

reading.ru: Иудеи, бывшие там, стали спрашивать друг друга, Куда это он собирается идти, что мы не сможем прийти туда?
reading.question: What confused the Jews about Jesus' statement that they could not go where he was going?
options: They wondered where he intended to go
They thought he was already dead
They believed he meant the Temple courts
reading.correct: They wondered where he intended to go
reading.explain: The Jews asked one another where he planned to go that they would not be able to reach.

reading.ru: Кто хочет пить, пусть приходит ко Мне и пьет.
reading.question: What invitation did Jesus give on the last, greatest day of the feast?
options: An invitation for anyone thirsty to come to him and drink
An invitation to eat bread with him
An invitation to leave the temple
reading.correct: An invitation for anyone thirsty to come to him and drink
reading.explain: Jesus stood and cried out that anyone who is thirsty should come to him and drink.

reading.ru: Третьи говорили, «Разве из Галилеи Христос придет? Разве не сказано в Писании, что Христос будет из рода Давида и из Вифлеема, того селения, откуда был Давид?»
reading.question: What objection did some in the crowd raise against Jesus being the Christ?
options: That the Christ could not come from Galilee but from David's line and Bethlehem
That the Christ must be a Roman citizen
That the Christ must be older than Jesus
That the Christ must be a Pharisee
reading.correct: That the Christ could not come from Galilee but from David's line and Bethlehem
reading.explain: Some argued that Scripture says the Christ comes from David's descendants and from Bethlehem, not Galilee.

reading.ru: После этого все разошлись по домам.
reading.question: How does the chapter end?
options: Everyone went to their own homes
reading.correct: Everyone went to their own homes
reading.explain: The final sentence states that after this, everyone went to their own homes.
